description: This file defines the RequestFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating HTTP request objects conforming to PSR-7 standards. It implements the RequestFactoryInterface and constructs Request instances using internal StreamFactory and UriFactory dependencies.

classes.name: RequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class for generating PSR-7 Request objects, utilizing internal stream and URI factories. Implements createRequest method that produces a fully constructed Request instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RequestFactory with optional stream and URI factories, defaulting to new instances if not provided.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new PSR-7 Request object for the given HTTP method and URI, converting strings to UriInterface as needed, and throwing an exception if the URI argument is incompatible.
